description: The probability a perp position touches its liquidation price within N hours (default 24), from Yang-Zhang and Garman-Klass volatility on the last week of hourly candles and a closed-form barrier formula, plus the most leverage that keeps that chance at targetPct (default 5%). Give the liquidation price, or leverage to work it out from the entry and the venue's maintenance margin.
name: liquidation_risk
title: Chance of touching a liquidation price
